caption_used: The effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family, with error bars indicating standard deviation. Six model configurations are compared across nine language families: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The IE-Indic family shows the largest effects overall, with most configurations reaching between 17 and 25, while Uralic and Isolate families show near-zero effects across all models. Notably, IE-Germanic exhibits consistently higher effects than IE-Romance across all configurations, with XLM-B2 reaching approximately 20 in IE-Germanic. The Semitic family displays the widest error bars overall, suggesting high variability, and the mBERT-L2 bars in Semitic reach approximately 15. In IE-Slavic, the B2 variants (mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2) dominate over the L2 and R2 variants, with effects approximately twice as large.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating the “effect” of context masking on case tasks across language families, comparing six model configurations. The horizontal axis is labeled “family” and lists nine categorical groups from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 10, 20, and 30 (bars extend slightly above 30 in one group). Each family contains six adjacent bars with error bars (standard deviation) and colors keyed by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). Approximate bar heights by family are: IE-Baltic shows small positive effects (mBERT-L₂ ~2, XLM-L₂ ~1, mBERT-R₂ ~3, XLM-R₂ ~3–4, mBERT-B₂ ~6, XLM-B₂ ~5) with modest error bars; IE-Germanic has mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near ~10 each, mBERT-R₂ near ~0, XLM-R₂ slightly below 0, and B₂ variants around ~15 (pink) and ~15 (red) with larger error bars; IE-Indic has L₂ near ~1 and ~0, R₂ around ~20 (light green) and ~18 (dark green), and B₂ around ~24 (pink) and ~21 (red), all with relatively large error bars; IE-Romance shows L₂ around ~6 (light blue) and ~4 (dark blue), R₂ around ~5 (light green) and ~1 (dark green), and B₂ around ~12–13 (pink) and ~6 (red); IE-Slavic shows L₂ around ~10 (light blue) and ~9 (dark blue), R₂ near ~1 (light green) and ~0 (dark green), and B₂ around ~17 (pink) and ~15–16 (red); IE-other shows L₂ around ~6 and ~6, R₂ near ~0 and ~0, and B₂ around ~8 (pink) and ~8 (red), with moderate error bars; Isolate bars cluster near zero to ~2 (light blue slightly below 0, dark blue near 0, greens around ~1–2, pink/red around ~1–2) with small error bars; Semitic shows larger values and the widest error bars, with mBERT-L₂ around ~11, XLM-L₂ around ~16, mBERT-R₂ around ~-2, XLM-R₂ around ~-1, mBERT-B₂ around ~15, and XLM-B₂ around ~19–20 (one error bar extending above ~30); Uralic shows near-zero effects across all six bars (roughly ~0–2) with small error bars. Bars are not visually sorted by height; they are grouped by family and consistently ordered within each group according to the legend.
